integrity: The all-parameter formula and the counterexample interval are proved analytically. The bundled script is a finite regression check only and is not used as evidence for an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the real square plane and does not propose a corrected attainment criterion for arbitrary Banach spaces. The principal originality risk is a later correction or poorly indexed equivalent computation not found in the searches.
title: Exact skew constant on the square plane and a sharp-attainment obstruction
